_comment: sim-place-release-serialization-v1 (the v4 follow-up to place-descent-residual-v3). coldwin43 CLEARED the set-down carton TILT (PR 333's contact-triggered weld release: CARTON_SEGMENT_TILT phase=place executed 1.57 deg, zero CARTON_TILT trips, closed_loop_sensor engaged, deck level 0.0, no non-deck SEAL contact) but then FAILED collect on a code SERIALIZATION bug at the release: the contact release fired MID place-descent and its detach mutated the planning scene while the place ExecuteTrajectory was STILL in flight -> the host adapter's _PLAN_IN_FLIGHT_STATES invariant tripped: RuntimeError 'planning-scene mutation issued while a plan/execute is in flight (state=execute_result)' -> HOST_FAULT_ESTOP phase=release. This lane makes the contact release a PROPER PHASE TRANSITION: on the trigger the controller CANCELS the in-flight place execute (the cancel is the stop -- the arm never keeps pressing the welded carton into the deck, which produced the 2.0 deg tilt in coldwin39-42), WAITS for the cancel's terminal (settled, not-in-flight) result with a bounded timeout, and only THEN detaches and continues withdraw (retreat) / verify from the settled pose. NOTHING about the 2.0 deg bound, the 0.15 s grace, carton dims, or the v2/v3 behaviours (drooped clearance, least-extended reach, station hold, closed_loop_sensor, place_contact_release/place_contact_gap_m) changes -- this is purely the release ORDERING.
_no_new_config_key: There is NO new HOST/RUNTIME config key -- config_preflight.py is UNCHANGED. The fix is in the controller state machine + the motion-port cancel protocol and is ALWAYS ACTIVE on the contact-release path (it only runs once place_contact_release has already fired, which is itself the opt-in v3 HOST key). The one new tunable is an internal ENV backstop, RESTOCK_RELEASE_CANCEL_SETTLE_S (default min(2.0, phase_timeout) sim seconds, clamped (0.1, phase_timeout]), bounding how long the release waits for the cancel to reach a terminal result before failing BY NAME -- not a mission config knob. Leave it unset for coldwin44.

_carton_level._file: HOST config scripts/twin/restock_manipulation/ros_host_config.json carton_level block -- UNCHANGED from coldwin43 (the place-descent-residual-v3 fragment). Reproduced here only to show coldwin44 keeps the EXACT coldwin43 carton_level block; this lane adds no carton_level key.

_requires: Same as coldwin43: the HOST carton_level block above PLUS collect_place_preplace_shape, collect_place_straight_line, collect_place_wrist_guard, carry_wrist1_cap / carry_wrist2_min, release_detach_timeout_s, and RESTOCK_VERIFY_PLACE (so sensors.placed_pose carries the live welded-carton centre the contact-release gate reads). Absent placed_pose => the contact-release gate is inert and this serialization path never engages (byte-identical).
_mechanism: On the contact trigger (carton_z <= release_z, logged PLACE_CONTACT_RELEASE) the controller sets a cancel-pending flag and transitions place->release. In the release phase it then: (1) calls motion.cancel() ONCE -- RosMotionPort.cancel() requests the action cancel (handle.cancel_goal_async) and fires NO global /manipulation/stop (unlike stop(); the global stop latches PERMANENTLY in the Isaac host), logging PLACE_CONTACT_RELEASE_CANCEL; (2) polls motion.cancel_outcome() each tick until a TERMINAL outcome -- 'cancelled' (normal), 'succeeded' (place completed before the cancel landed), 'error' (broken terminal), or None (still settling) -- cancel_outcome() drives the adapter state OUT of _PLAN_IN_FLIGHT_STATES and invalidates late callbacks (generation bump) WITHOUT any emergency stop; (3) on 'cancelled'/'succeeded' (logged PLACE_CONTACT_RELEASE_SETTLED) falls through to the gripper-open then, once contact clears, update_payload(False) -- the detach is now LEGAL because the state is terminal; (4) on None past RESTOCK_RELEASE_CANCEL_SETTLE_S sim, or on 'error', FAILS BY NAME and NEVER detaches into an in-flight/broken scene. The normal (poll-succeeded) place->release path leaves the cancel-pending flag False and is byte-identical.
_acceptance_coldwin44: A real GPU collect run (integration lane; this worker never takes /tmp/aile-gpu.lock) with the coldwin43 config: (1) PLACE_CONTACT_RELEASE recorded at deck contact (as coldwin43); (2) NO HOST_FAULT_ESTOP at phase=release and NO 'planning-scene mutation issued while a plan/execute is in flight' anywhere -- instead PLACE_CONTACT_RELEASE_CANCEL then PLACE_CONTACT_RELEASE_SETTLED outcome=cancelled, then the weld detaches (release_detach_timeout_s) and the empty-gripper retreat begins; (3) collect COMPLETES and the run advances PAST collect (into the couple/transit tail) rather than e-stopping at release; (4) CARTON_TILT peak <= 1.5 deg (the carried carton never pressed into the deck -- the cancel stops the press at contact, trigger->cancel-settled well inside the 0.15 s grace: coldwin43's release cadence is ~0.0176 s/tick, the cancel settles in ~1-3 ticks); (5) the carton left resting flat on the cart deck.
_cpu_proof: PYTHONPATH=scripts python3 -m pytest scripts/twin/tests/test_place_release_serialization_v1.py -- the ADAPTER contract (RosMotionPort.update_payload guards every _PLAN_IN_FLIGHT_STATES and reproduces the exact coldwin43 crash string; cancel()/cancel_outcome() drain to a terminal not-in-flight state with NO emergency_stop; every terminal outcome handled) and the CONTROLLER state machine (cancel-then-detach ordering, update_payload NEVER called while in flight, succeeded-before-cancel still detaches, the bounded-timeout and error paths fail by name and never detach, the release-not-a-trip-phase property, and the trigger->cancel-settled < 0.15 s grace proof on the coldwin43 cadence). Also re-run the v3 suite (unchanged): scripts/twin/tests/test_place_descent_residual_v3.py. The only expected failure in the full suite is the pre-existing 180-degree-pole test.
